changes: Selected controls are now consistently white, while hover colours clearly distinguish Options from Emulation settings.
Sliders stay visually calm while dragging and reveal their hover highlight only after the pointer leaves and returns.
Library filters are now flat and shadow-free, with separate animations for Add ROM and switching library views.
Save-state cards now capture the real game screen and preserve whether the state belongs to the Game Boy or Game Boy Color.
Dark-mode ON, OFF, year, and helper labels remain readable across every highlighted control.
The README now opens with all three current screenshots and explains the single-file experience, library, LCD, and save tools more clearly.
